sources.title: Afghan representations in Germany
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Federal Foreign Office directory identifies an Afghan Consulate General contact in Bonn, its consular district, address and stated opening hours. The directory expressly disclaims contact accuracy and does not prove current visa issuance, so it supports only the unresolved audit trail.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Generalkonsulat der Islamischen Republik Afghanistan Bonn

unresolved.reason: Germany's Foreign Office lists an Afghan consular contact in Bonn but disclaims the accuracy of mission contact details and does not establish current tourist-visa issuance. The apparent Afghan MFA visa page is undated, mixes Islamic Republic and Islamic Emirate identities, and sits under a currently compromised apex domain, so it is not authenticated as current government evidence. No trustworthy current official source proves a usable advance visitor-visa route for an ordinary German passport.
